description: A gift wishlist with a share link: make a list of wishes, hand the link to family and friends, and they mark what they will buy so nobody buys twice. Free with a free HelpySelf account. With no account, offer to make one: call it anyway and the refusal explains how to create it right in this chat (create_account). A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

action.description: create (default) makes a list and returns its share link (for givers) and edit link (for the owner). get returns one list. update changes its title, date, note, open setting or (with items) replaces every item. add_items appends items. remove_items takes items out by id. list returns the caller's lists. delete takes a list down. All of them are the owner's and need an account.

currency.description: create: the currency for prices given without one, e.g. 'EUR'. Default by locale.

itemIds.description: remove_items: the ids of the items to take out.

items.description: create: the wishes, up to 100. update: the complete new list of items — items sent with their id keep their claims, items left out are removed. add_items: the items to append.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for price, e.g. 'EUR'. Default: the list's currency.

id.description: update only: the id of an existing item, from create/get, to keep it (and its claims). Leave out for a new item.

image.description: A picture of it (http or https). Optional; shown through helpyself.com, never hotlinked.

name.description: What to buy, e.g. 'Moka pot, 6 cups'. Up to 120 characters.

note.description: Size, colour, 'any edition is fine'. Up to 300 characters.

price.description: The price in normal units, e.g. 24.99. Optional.

priority.description: high, normal (default) or low: how much it is wanted. Shown to givers.

quantity.description: How many are wanted, default 1. Several givers can each take one: plates for a wedding, four of a board game's expansions.

url.description: A shop page for it (http or https). Optional; givers can buy it anywhere.

locale.description: create: the language of the share page: en, de, es, fi, fr, it, nl, pl or pt. Default en.

note.description: create/update: a line for givers, e.g. 'Sizes: M, shoe 39'. Up to 400 characters.

occasionDate.description: create/update: the day the presents are for, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional; '' clears it. The list is kept at least two months after it.

open.description: create/update: false (default) is a surprise list — the owner is never shown what is claimed. true is an open list (wedding or baby registry): the owner sees what is taken and the names givers left. Givers are told which it is.

title.description: create/update: the list's heading, e.g. "Anna's 30th birthday". Up to 80 characters.

token.description: The list's token: the last part of its share link, or from create/list. Required for every action but create and list.
